capabilities: highlight PDF passages with six mark styles and customizable colors
write, pin, and position margin note cards beside the page
organize annotations into separate visible or hidden sets
search the annotation list and jump to any mark's page
run AI annotation jobs over a page range into a chosen set
extras: Desktop-only. AI annotation is opt-in, uses the user's own provider and may incur charges, and stores the API key unencrypted in device-local application storage outside the vault. Annotation mode creates a duplicate recovery copy of each PDF (~one extra PDF's worth of vault storage), and the .pdf-annotator/ folder must be included in any sync or backup that excludes hidden folders.
problem: Obsidian can display PDFs but offers no built-in way to highlight passages, attach notes, search them, or keep them linked to the document.

requires.name: AI provider API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen, Kimi, or custom endpoint)
AI provider account, which may charge for requests

summary: PDF annotation layer that adds highlights, margin note cards, annotation sets, and Markdown sidecar storage to Obsidian's native PDF viewer.
